title: CASSSIDECAR-347 Improve FilteringMetricRegistry implementation
notes: First Sidecar case (4 files, +293/-17; medium tier). Head is the landed trunk commit (squash of PR #261). The hard issue is from CASSSIDECAR-349 (created 2025-09-29, two days after the case landed), whose description says the race was introduced in CASSSIDECAR-347, and its fix commit 56e2bb0f: addExcludedMetricIfNotExists nulls the cached allMetrics inside the computeIfAbsent mapping function, before the new metric is in excludedMetrics, so a concurrent getMetrics() can rebuild and cache allMetrics without it; the metric then stays missing from getMetrics() until the next invalidation. Lines are at the head: FilteringMetricRegistry.java:284-293 (the invalidation) against getMetrics at 164-195. A concurrency lens finding is the expected catch. Training contamination: the fix post-dates the case head but pre-dates mid-2026 model cut-offs, so a model may have seen it. The Sidecar lens notes in docs/research/sidecar-standards.md cite review comments from PRs merged after the cut-off (for example #390 on check-then-act cache invalidation); they describe the defect class, not this bug, but recheck if the notes are edited to name it. First panel run (2026-11-20, Sonnet): found by five of six lenses.

known_issues.summary: allMetrics is nulled inside computeIfAbsent before the excluded metric is added, so a concurrent getMetrics() caches a map without it
